caveat./revitalizing-and-strengthening/: We do not treat cancer itself. Our doctors provide supportive care alongside your oncologist’s treatment — they will tell you what is possible at consultation.
caveat./womens-hormonal-balance-endocrine-thera: Endocrine and hormonal care. An Ayurvedic doctor confirms at consultation whether it suits your diagnosis.

caveat./treatment-for-paralysis/: Rehabilitation rather than acute care. Our doctors confirm at consultation whether this is the right stage for you.

ui.zero: No page matches “{q}”. Try a condition (back pain, psoriasis), a place (airport) or a question (visa).
ui.notSure: Not sure? Our doctors decide what suits you, at consultation.
ui.urgent: If this has just started, please speak to a person rather than a search box: call +91 9555 156 156, or your local emergency service if it is severe. Kairali is an NABH-accredited Ayurvedic hospital, not an emergency service.
ui.declined: This is not something we treat. We do not treat HIV or AIDS, active communicable diseases, or cancer itself. Supportive care alongside treatment you are having elsewhere is a different matter — an Ayurvedic doctor can judge your case at consultation.
ui.consultFirst: We would rather talk to you about this than point you at a programme. Tell us in your own words and an Ayurvedic doctor will place it.
ui.multi: More than one programme may apply. If you are dealing with several things at once, the Personalised Programme is usually the right starting point.
